tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bde chen 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bde chen 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan khams gsum dbang phyug thugs rje'i stobs/ /bde chen rdo rje 'chang dbang he ru ka /dpag yas mkha' 'gro dra bar mnyam sbyor ba/ /ye shes lhan cig skyes sku de la 'dud/ /gang zhig dkyil 'khor cho ga bdud rtsi'i sgo/ /brgya phrag phye las thar mchog khang bzang du/ /mtha' yas skye bo 'jug pa'i dga' ston can/ /grub pa'i 'bras bu sbyin 'di ya mtshan chos/ /de la slob dpon dam pa bsgom pa dang bzlas pas rang nyid byin gyis rlobs pa'i gnas thob pa dag gis slob ma dam pa theg pa mchog 'dir mos pa'i skal ba can dag dbang bskur ba yang dag par sbyin nas rjes su bzung bar bya'o/ /dbang bskur ba de yang dkyil 'khor bya ba sngon du 'gro ba can yin no/ /de la 'dir de kho na nyid bcu gcig ste/ gsol gdab bsnyen pa sa chog dang*/ /sta gon thig gdab tshon yang dgye/ /rgyan dgod sgrub pa bdag nyid 'jug /slob bzung rjes kyi bya ba'o/ /de ltar na slob ma'i gsol ba gdab pa/ dbang gi don du kha gsos bsnyen pa/ sa'i cho ga sta gon du gnas pa/ thig gdab pa/ tshon dbye ba/ rgyan dang yo byad dgod pa/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa/ bdag nyid 'jug pa/ slob ma bzung ba/ rjes kyi bya ba'o/ /dang po gsol ba gdab pa ni/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul ba ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa ston pa po/ /'jig rten rnams kyi 'dren mdzad lha/ /'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du/ /bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ slob dpon gyis/ 'khor lo'i mchod pa rim ji bzhin/ /khyod kyis thams cad 'byor gyur tam/ /gus pas rnal 'byor ma rnams dang*/ /rnal 'byor dga' bar byed nus sam/ zhes dris pa las/ 'byor gyur te/ zhes dang*/ byed nus so zhes lan btab bo/ /yang 'di skad ces/

da ma tshig skyong zhing ston byed pa/ /bu khyod kyis ni spro gyur tam/ / zhes pa la/ bdag ni rab tu spro gyur to/ / zhes lan btab/ skabs 'dir slob ma la bgegs dang sdig pa sbyang ba byas pa'i rjes su/ sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar bsrung 'khor sgom/ zhal bzhi pa bzlas pa'i srung skud mgul bar btags/ smon lam dang bkra shis brjod pa sogs bya'o/ /gnyis pa bsnyen pa la/ lha nye ba'i bsnyain pa ni/ sgrubs thabs bzhin lha'i rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor 'khor lo rdzogs par bsgoms nas/ gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po khri phrag gsum/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi la lnga stong lnga brgya bzla/ 'khor lo gsum la khri phrag gnyis re/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad la'ang lnga stong lnga brgya re bzla ste/ rgyas pa'i lugs yin la/ 'khor lo gsum gyi bzlas pa spangs pa 'bring po dang*/ gtso bo yab yum kho na bzla ba bsdus pa'o/ /snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi zhal bzhi pa dang spel ba dang*/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad la yab kyi rkang brgyad dang spel ba'i lugs kyang yod de/ de ltar 'grub na shin tu legs so/ /bgegs zhi bas bsnyen pa ni/ 'og tu 'chad pa ltar las bum du las kyi lha sgrub pa ni nges pa yin la/ rgya bod ky-i bla ma snga rabs pa mang po'i bzhed pas/ bum chog bzhin du dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad sgrub par bshad de/ de ltar yang grub na bzang ngo*/ /ye shes dbab pa'i bsnyen pa ni/ thod pa'i nang du ye shes 'bebs pas rdzas rnams bzhag la/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha mahā krod+dha sogs dang*/ dbyangs skyong ba'i sngags bzla ba yin te/ bdag nyid gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis rdzas la sngags kyi yig 'bru 'bebs pa'i tshul gyis so/ /de ltar bsnyen pa gsum ka ma 'grub na/ dang po lha nye ba'i bsnyen pa nyid gtso bo yin pa'i de bya'o/ /bsnyen pa dang gsol gdab la snga phyi nges pa med pas ji ltar bde ba yin no/ /gsum pa sa chog la/

sa brtag pa/ sa bslang ba/ sbyang ba/ bzung ba bzhi las/ dang po ni/ spyi dang 'dra zhing gzhung du'ang lta'o/ /gnyis pa la gnas kyi bdag po las bslang ba/ 'jig rten skyong ba las bslang ba/ dkyil 'khor lha las bslang ba/ sa'i lha mo las bslang ba'o/ /dang po ni/ bdag nyid dpal he ru kar gyur/ gtor ma dang mchod pa/ sum+bhas bsangs/ swabhā was sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gis byin gyis rlabs/ oṃ gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams dang*/ sarba k+ṣe ṭa pha la sa pa ri wa re bh+ya/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ā t+ya nut+pan+na twa ta oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum mam lnga sogs kyis phul/ ar+ghaṃ= nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ gang yang 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la/ /dkyil 'khor don du sa 'di ni/ / bdag zhu khyed kyis stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab ste/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te phyir dor/ gnyis pa ni/ dur khrod brgyad na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong la sogs pa 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad spyan drangs par mos te/ oṃ ak+ka dha na basban dha na khak+khā da na sarba duṣ+ta na ha na ha da ghā ta ya/ ma ma shān ti ku ru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa dzaḥswāhā/ zhes pas bkug ste/ oṃ kha kha khwa hi khwa hi nas ma mā sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu swāhā/ lan gsum sogs kyis phul/ ar+ghaṃ= la sogs pa'i mchod/ khams gsum gnas pa'i lha dang klu /gnod sbyin dri za lha ma yin/ /gang dag rdzu 'phrul che ldan zhing*/ /'byung po bstan pa la dga' bas/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /sangs rgyas rnams la mchod pa dang*/ /sems can rnams la phan don du/ /sa phyogs dge ba 'di nyid du/ /dam pa'i dkyil 'khor cher 'byung ba/ /ji ltar bsam pa'i las byed ni/ /khyed kyi bar chad ma byed par/ /dge ba'i grogs po nyid du mdzod/ ces lan gsum/ gats+tsha gats+tsha swa s+tha naṃ/ zhes rol mo dang bcas te gtor ma phyir dor/

gsum pa ni dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhir skyang nul bya/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan bzhi bcu zhe gcig brjod la lha'i gnas su dri bzang gis thig le bya/ mañja'i steng du thod pa bzhag la/ der me tog 'bul bzhin pas/ lha thams cad kyi snying po lan gsum gsum brjod/ spro zhing dgos na/ dbus kyi lte bar 'khor lo bde mchog / ces pa nas/ me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo nas/ rdo rje'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa'i bar la/ mkha' gsang byin rlabs rjes chags dang bcas pa dor/ lhag ma rnams brjod do/ / bsdu na/ 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis skad cig gis grub par gyur/ zhes brjod/ sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar/ ar+ghaṃ= nas shap+ta 'i bar sngags kyis mchod/ rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod/ dus gsum 'byung ba'i mgon po rnams/ /bdag la brtse bas dgongs su gsol/ /mgon po rgyal ba sras mchod cing*/ /slob ma rnams la sman slad du/ /dpal ldan rdo rje he ru ka'i/ /kyil 'khor dam pa 'bri 'tshal bas/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis/ /bdag la byin rlabs mchog gnang mdzod/ ces lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ yo ga shud+dho sogs rang la stim/ yang na/ badz+ra muḥs gshegs su gsol/ bzhi pa ni/ sa non gyi phyag rgyas sor mo dbus ma gsum pa la reg ste/ ṭak+ki ni hūṃ dzaḥ lan gsum/ haṃ gi sgra dang hūṃ gi 'od kyis bskul nas sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa 'byung*/ tshom bu'i steng du byon pa ni sa'i lha mo gser gyi mdog can zhi ba'i nyams dang ldan pa/ phyag gnyis kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i rin po che bum pa bsnams pa rgyan dang na bza' dkar po can/ kye rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bgyi ba bka' stsal du gsol/ zhes gsung bar gyur/ bdag bskyed ltar mchod pa byin gyis brlab/ oṃ pri thī wi de wī bh+yaḥ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/

de sngon du 'gro ba'i pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi te/ shap+ta/ ghaṇ+ḍe sogs rol mo/ gtor ma sum bha swabhā/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ oṃ pri thī wi de wī bh+yaḥ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ/ gṛh+ṇa daṃ ba liṃ ta ye swāhā/ lan gsum/ oṃ tshur byon tshur byon sa yi ni/ /lha mo chen mo 'jig rten yum/ /rin chen kun gyi rab gang ma/ /bzang po'i rgyan gyi rnam brgyan ma/ /do shal rkang gdub sgra ldan ma/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab mchod ma/ /mchod gtor 'di dag mchod nas su/ /dkyil 'khor las ni legs grub mdzod/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /he ru ka dpal dpa' bo yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi stobs bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri/ lan gsum/ sa'i lha mo'i 'khor dang bcas pa rnams mchod gtor dam pa 'dis tshim par mdzad pa/ bdag gi bsnyen pa rdzogs pa'i dpang po yang mdzad cing*/ dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i don du sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ kye rig pa 'dzin pa sa gzhi sems med cing dag par 'tshal ba'i las ci bde bar mdzod cig oṃ pra thī de wī bh+yaḥ.ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra u ti la sa'i lha mo/ nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ rgya bod kha cig sa lha las slangs pa mi byed pa'ang yod de byed pa legs so/ /gsum pa sbyangs pa la gsum gyi/ mes sbyangs pa ni/ zhi ba dang drag po'i sbyin bsreg gi bgegs dang mi shis pa sbyangs pa'o/ /gnyis pa chus sbyangs pa ni/ las thams cad pa 'das pa'i chus gtor ba'o/

/gsum pa sa'i bya ba sbyangs pa ni/ rko sbyangs zug rngu dbyung ba sogs yin la/ de dag dngos su byed pa med na ting nge 'dzin gyis sbyangs te/ oṃ bhu khaṃ nam mkha'i rang bzhin du gyur/ hūṃ laṃ hūṃ rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ me dhi/ nas ban+dha hūṃ/ zhes so/ /rgya bod kha cig sgrub thabs ltar/ skyabs 'gro nas tshogs zhing sogs mtshams su 'di byed cing*/ de rnams kyis sa byin gyis rlabs par bsam la yig brgya brjod pa sogs byed de 'gal ba med la nges par dgos pa ni ma yin no/ /bzhi pa bzung ba la/ byin gyis rlabs pa dang srung ba gnyis kyi/ dang po la gsum/ lha'i rnal 'byor gyis byin gyis rlabs pa/ drag po'i 'phrin las kyi byin gyis rlabs pa/ stang stabs kyi byin gyis rlabs pa'o/ /dang po ni dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhir 'dug la/ skyabs 'gro nas bzlas pa rdzogs kyi bar/ sgrub thabs las 'byung ba ltar nyams su len pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ phyogs bzhi slob dpon so so'i/ thog mar shar nas mchod pa byin rlabs bdag bskyed ltar bya/ ar+ghaṃ sogs dang rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ rdo rje slob dpon chen po la dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon mdzad pa'i don du dbul bar/ sogs bya/ lho mas/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ shar mas/ mtshan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /mtshan min thams cad yang dag spangs/ /kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ byang mas/ zhi ba'i mchog ni chos las byung*/ /ye shes spyod pa rnam sbyong ba/ /kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ nub mas/ sems can kun gyi sems chen po/ /rang bzhin dag cing dri ma med/ /kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo sgyur/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra u tiṣ+ṭha/

sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ rang gtso bo'i thugs ka nas gtso bo gnyis par chad/ skabs 'dir rgya bod kyi slob dpon spros pa la dgyes pa rnams/ rang nyid khro bo hūṃ mdzad khams gsum rnam rgyal zhal gsum phyag drug par bskyed par 'dug na'ang bsdus pa la gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis chog go / mig g.yas g.yon ma dang ṭa las nyi ma dang zla bar mig 'bras hūṃ las rdo rje nag po khro bo'i tshogs kyi 'od zer 'phro ba dang*/ rkang mthil gnyis su āḥlas sna tshogs rdo rje 'od zer 'phro ba/ oṃ pra ṇa mi sarba ta thā ga taṃ badz+ra driṣ+ta ma ṭa/ rdo rje lta bas g.yas g.yon du bskor te/ lta bas bgegs bskrad/ sa phyogs 'dir sems can gyi don rtsom gyis/ lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang dri za dang srin po dang srin mo la sogs pa/ gang dag gnas pa'i sa'i bdag po myur du songs shig /'dir dpal he ru ka'i bka' nos la myur ba nyid du songs shig /gang dag mi 'gro ba de la nga'i ye shes kyi rdo rje dang kha ṭ+waṃ ga 'dis spyi bo nas rnam pa brgyad dgas par bya'o/ / lan gsum/ re re'i mthar sum bha bzlas shing 'bud dkrol bya/ yungs dkar gyis sa gzhi la gtor ro/ /gsum pa ni/ hūṃ glur len cing dbang ldan du song la/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang*/ rtse gsum pa dang*/ rtse lnga pa'i 'gros kyis bskor ba dang*/ shar du g.yon brkyang*/ byang du sa ga nub tu zlum po/ lhor g.yas brkyang rnams thabs shes kyi dbye bas brgyad du 'gyur ba rnams dang*/ gzhan yang dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje 'bri zhing mnyam pa'i rkang stabs dang ji ltar rig par gyen du 'degs pa/ thur du bskyod pa dang*/ thad kar bskyod pa dang*/ g.yas dang g.yon du bskor ba dang*/ 'byed 'khyud dang ku tsa nyed pa dang*/ nag ga ha da na da ka/ tsu na sha dang skra grol ba/ zhes brgyad dang*/ rkang pa bskyod dang lag pa bskyod/ /smin ma 'degs dang rab rgyas

grang*/ /cung zad ngo tsha'i zur mig dang*/ /brla rgyas lta na sdug pa dang*/ /mig yangs gar ni byed 'gyur zhing*/ kha yi pad+ma 'dzum pa dang*/ /cung zad dmar ba'i mche ba 'phyang*/ /kun da ltar dkar so yi 'phreng*/ /zhes pa ltar gar gyi rnam par rol pa rnams bya zhing*/ stang stabs kyi spros pa la mi dga' na/ ji ltar rigs pa'i bskor ba gsum bya'o/ /gnyis pa bsrung ba la gnyis kyi/ dang po sa gzhi bsrung ba ni/ phur bu bcu'am gcig bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ bcu las byung ba'i steng dang shar gyi phur bu kha gdong ma nag mo/ / sogs sgo mtshams ma brgyad mngon rtog bzhin nam/ gcig las med na/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sku mdog nag po rdo rje 'phyar zhing*/ sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa thugs kar gtod pa ste/ gang ltar yang lte ba man chad phur bu'i dbyibs can du nas rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' phaiṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sum+bha= mang du bzlas/ 'dir yang rgya bod spros pa la dgyes pa rnams mngon brjod las 'byung ba'i khro bo bcur bskyed pa bzhed do/ /de nas/ oṃ sum+bha= zhes pa nas steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad bcings par gyur/ gyis bar bsrung 'khor bzhin/

phur bu bsrung ba'i khro mo rnams sprul phur bu bsrung ba'i don du phyogs bcur bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du/ puṣ+pe/ bas+t+ra/ sarga pa/ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe āḥhūṃ ji srid dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bgegs thams cad bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig gnyis pa bdag nyid bsrung ba ni/ rang gi snying gar oṃ aṃ ha ེ nas sum+bha= lan gnyis kyis phyogs bcings pa'i bar/ mnyam langs bsrung ba'i rnal 'byor gyi skabs dang 'dra/ smon lam dang bkra shis ci ltar 'os par bya zhing ras bris kyi phyogs la ni sa'i cho ga 'di mi dgos so/ /nyi ma dang po'i cho ga'o/ /bzhi pa sta gon du gnas pa la/ sta gon gyi snga rol du sgrub dgos pa'i cho ga dang*/ sta gon dngos so/ /dang po ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma/ gnas yo byin gyis rlabs/ zhu 'bul/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i ting nge 'dzin rnams so/ /de yang sngon 'gro gtor ma la sum+bhas bsangs/ swa bha wa sa sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ zhes byin gyis rlabs/ phaiṃ zhes mgron rnams spyan drangs/ oṃ kha kha khā h-i khā hi nas bha wan+tu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ lha'i tshogs rnams/ nas 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa khyad par can gong nas gong du yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir dang*/ 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs su gsol te/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang*/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur bar 'tshal na/ dkar po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i phyogs skyong ba'i bsrung ma rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ ji srid dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du/

bgegs rnams bzlog cing 'dod pa'i don thams cad sgrub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ gang dag nag pa'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba thams cad sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig /sum+bha bzlas drag rol bya gtor ma phyir dor ro/ /de nas gnas dang yo byad byin gyis rlabs pa ni/ sum+bhas bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ gnas khang hūṃ yig las byung ba'i bsrung 'khor gyi nang du/ bhūṃ las byung ba'i gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs rdzogs pa'i nang du a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba/ rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i/ lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod pa rnams/ rgyu 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba las byung ba/ ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba/ yul nam mkha'i mthas khyab pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stong gi bar du/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig /oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra pad+yaṃ/ de bzhin du/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi te/ shap+ta/ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ a brta ya/ a brta ya ho/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghan+dai ra ṇi ta pra ra ṇi ta saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li te/ pra dz+nyā pā ra mi ta na da sam+bha we/ badz+ra dharma hri da ya ni son+to ṣa ṇi hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ho ho ho a khāṃ swāhā/ zhes rol mo byin 'beb kyi sngags dang*/ gzhan yang mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs la sogs pa ci rigs pa bzlas shing byin dbab bo/ /zhu 'bul ni/ tshogs pa yod na tshogs kyi gtso bo la gsol gdab pa'i don yin pas byas na legs par 'gyur te/

byed tshul spyi dang 'dra'o/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ mnyam langs/ bsrung ba'i rnal 'byor rdzogs kyi bar ram/ zhing skyong dag pa gsum gyi bar du byas kyang rung ste/ bdag bskyed kyi rnal 'byor rgyas pa nyid rdzogs par bsgom pa yin no/ /gnyis pa sta gon du gnas pa dngos la/ sa'i lha mo sta gon du gnas pa dang*/ lha sta gon du gnas pa dang*/ bum pa sta gon du gnas pa dang*/ slob ma sta gon du gnas pa'o/ /dang po ni dkyil 'khor gyi sa bzhir sa bla'i tshom bu bkod mchod gtor bshams/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa tshom bu'i steng du byon pa ni/ zhes pa nas/ rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor 'bri'i bar gong bzhin/ kye rig pa 'dzin pa dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar mdzod cig oṃ pri thī wi de wī bh+yaḥ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ sa'i lha mo slar yang sa gzhi de nyid la thim bar gyur/ ras bris kyi cho ga la ni sngar nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i bteg pa med pas/ sa gnon gyi phyag rgya sa la reg pa nas gzung*/ dkyil 'khor 'bri zhes pa'i bar sa chog gi skabs bzhin bya ba ni khyad par ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ shar dang steng gi phur bu khwa gdong ma nag po sogs nas/ lte ba man chad phur bu'i dbyibs can du gyur/ badz+ra gan+dhe? nas bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig bar gong bzhin no/ /de nas da lta'i lag len ltar na/ thig btab la/ gtso bo'i gnas su dri bzang gis thig le gru bzhi pa dang*/ lha gnas gzhan rnams su zlum por byed/ de rnams su me tog gi tshom bu re bkod/ mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/ sum bha sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i rtse mor/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang nas mchod pa sna tshogs pas gang ba'o/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan bzhi bcu zhe gcig brjod de/

dri bzang tshom bu thig le dang bcas pa gdan du byin gyis rlobs pa'o/ /de nas lha thams cad kyi snying po sngags mchod bzhin las so sor lan gsum gsum brjod/ bde chen 'khor lo'i dbus kyi lte bar nas/ me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i 'dab ma brgyad la nas/ rdo rje'i 'phreng ba'i mtshan pa'o/ /lha thams cad kyi dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ yig gi 'od zer gyis/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na bzhugs pa'i nas dbang gi lha rnams rang la gnyis su med par thim gyis bar yang sgrub thabs bzhin no/ /sa chog gi skabs nam mkha' bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ ye shes pa'i zhor la spyan drangs pa yin pas/ sgos su spyan 'dren mi byed pa'i lugs yin la/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gzhan mang po dag la'ang 'di lta bu yod do/ /de nas mchod pa ni/ rgyas bsdus ji ltar 'os pa bya/ 'jig rten 'das gtor skabs 'dir phul kyang chog ste mchod par 'grel ba'i phyir ro/ /de nas snyan gsan dbab pa ni bdud rtsi lnga dang sha chen sbyar ba'i spos snod thogs te/ gnyis med ye shes las byung ba/ khyab bdag dngos kun bdag nyid can/ /ston pa'i gtso bo khrag 'thung dpal/ /phag mo lhan cig yang dag ldan/ /gang zhig phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang*/ /rig pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul can/ /byang chub sems dpa' la sogs kun/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su stsol/ /slob ma la ni phan pa dang*/ /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje can bdag 'di zhes pas/ /nang par dkyil 'khor 'bri bar bgyi/ /rjes su brtse bar nyer dgongs te/ /kun gyi byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum mo/ /yang na gsang ba spyi rgyud nas 'byung ba ltar la/ he ru ka dpal bcom ldan 'das nas zhes dang*/ he ru ka 'byung dkyil 'khor 'di/ / zhes 'don pa spos te brjod kyang rung ngo*/

/nyi ma de nyid la dkyil 'khor nam mkhar mi 'degs na/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi la sogs pa'i sngags tshan drug bsrung 'khor nas 'byung ba ltar brjod la/ mtshams bcing pa yin kyang lag len mi bde'o/ /de nas gtor ma 'bul bar bya ste/ sum bha 'i bsangs ba nas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum gyi bar/ sa ma ya staṃ nas rjes brtser mdzad du gsol/ /sum bha 'i mthar/ a kā ro/ / btags pa phur bu rnams la yang phul/ bar 'dir nag po chen po la sogs pa sgos kyi chos skyong la gtor ma 'bul bar spro na 'bul/ de nas oṃ kha kha 3 nas / yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar gyis 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma phul/ rjes kyi bya ba ni/ mtshams 'di nas yig brgyas kha bskang ba man chad byas kyang chog la/ deng sang gi lag len ltar na bum pa sgrub pa'i rjes su byed do/ /gsum pa ni rtag pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i lugs la/ lha sum cu so bdun la bum pa re re/ rnam rgyal dang las bum ste zhe dgur 'dod cing*/ bde chen 'khor lo'i lnga dang sgo ma bzhi'i re re ste dgur yang 'chad do/ /'on kyang 'di'i gtso bum dang rnam rgyal tha dad du byas pa ni ha cang legs pa ma yin no/ /'jigs med 'byung gnas kyi zhal snga nas/ bde chen 'khor lo'i lnga/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad/ 'khor lo gsum la phyogs mtshams phye bas drug ste/ las bum gciganyi shu 'am/ 'khor lo lnga la bum pa re re dang*/ gtso bum las bum ste/ bdun nam/ 'khor lo lnga dang las bum ste drug kyang bzhed la/ bde chen 'khor lo'i lnga dang*/ 'khor lo lhag ma bzhi la re re ste dgur yang mdzad do/ /bhu ba blo ldan gyis ni/ gtso bo yab yum dang*/ rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang*/ mtshams kyi bum pa bzhi ste dgu zhes dang*/ dge slong dā ri ka pas bkra shis khrus kyi bum pa brgyad dang*/ dbang bskur rgyal ba'i bum pa/ dung chos rnam rgyal zhes 'dod pas rgyal ba rnam rgyal gyi ngos 'dzin dus 'khor dang bstun par snang la/

lhag ma grub chen nag po spyod pa'i dgongs pa yang 'di nyid yin no/ /'dod tshul tha dad pa de dag las/ bum pa dgur byed pa rnams kyi lugs thams cad dang mthun par/ bcu pa ni las bum mo/ /bsdu na gnyis su byed pa yang thams cad dgongs pa mthun pas/ skabs 'dir 'di ltar bya/ bum pa mang na lha grangs dang mnyam pa yin yang*/ da ltar lag len byed pa nyung la/ 'bring du na bum pa bcu ste/ rnam rgyal bum pa dang*/ khrus kyi bum pa brgyad dang las bum mo/ /nyung ba la gnyis te rnam rgyal bum pa dang las bum mo/ /de la rnam rgyal bum par dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yongs rdzogs bskyed dgos shing*/ las bum du ni hūṃ mdzad 'jig rten gsum rgyal bskyed pa dang*/ he ru ka yab rkyang*/ shin tu khros pa zhig bskyed pa dang*/ dum skyes ma bskyed pa dang bdud rtsi 'khyil pa bskyed pa rnams la dkyil 'khor chog so so'i khungs re thams cad la yod kyang*/ lag len du dum skyes ma bskyed par mdzad do/ /bum pa'i mtshan ma yang*/ bum pa mang ba'i phyogs la lha so so'i phyag mtshan gdan dang bcas pa 'god cing*/ yab yum gnyis gnyis bzhugs pa la'ang phyag mtshan gnyis kar 'god pa dang*/ yab kyi phyag mtshan kho na 'god pa'i lugs gnyis yod cing*/ dgu'i phyogs la 'dod tshul sna tshogs yod kyang*/ skabs 'dir rnam rgyal bum pa la rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan/ bkra shis khrus kyi bum pa brgyad la gri gug /las bum la'ang rang lha'i phyag mtshan 'god dgos pas dum skyes ma'i gri gug go /mtshan ma rnams kyang lto ba'am kha'i g.yel kha'am/ mchu 'phyang gang la bkod kyang 'dra ste dgos don mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /bum pa rnams gos zung gis g.yogs/ mgrin par srad bu dkar pos lan bdun du dkris/ 'bras so ba dang*/ mon sran dang*/ nas dang*/ gro dang*/ til te 'bru lnga dang*/ mu tig gser mu min/ byu ru dngul te rin po che lnga dang*/ kan+dha ka ri dang*/

sle tre dang*/ rgya mtsho'i sbu ba dang*/ chu srin sder mo dang*/ shu thag dkar po ste sman lnga dang*/ gur gum/ ga bur tsan+dan dkar dmar gla rtsi ste dri lnga dang*/ me tog kha dog sna lnga ste nyi shu rtsa lnga po'am/ me tog gi dod du/ 'o ma/ mar/ sbrang rtsi/ bu ram/ lan tshwa ste/ snying po lnga byed pa'ang yod pa/ spyir gnyis kar rung yang skabs 'dir me tog rigs lnga gtso bor bya ste/ de rnams/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ bzla bzhin du bum par gzhug go kha rgyan/ yal 'dab/ me tog /'bras bu sogs ldan pa'i shing dge mtshan can gyi lcugs mas bya/ gu gul gyis bdugs/ zhal bzhi pas sngags bzlas pa'i yungs dkar gyis bgegs bskrad/ dri bzang gi chus dgang ngo*/ /dung chos sam thod pa dri bzang gi chus gang ba'i steng du gzungs thag rdo rje dang bcas pa yang steng du bzhag /de nas mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor la/ mchod pa byin rlabs bya/ bum pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ sna tshogs pad+ma bcu'i steng*/ a rnams las zla ba'i gdan re re/ de rnams kyi steng du bh+ruṃ rnams las rin po che'i bum pa lto ba ldir zhing*/ mgrin pa phra ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyi mgul bcing dang*/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba'i dbus kyi bum pa'i nang du 'khor lo bde mchog= nas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i shar du mkha' 'gro= nas rdo rje'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa'o/ /rnam rgyal bum pa'i steng gi mtshan ma hūṃ las mi bskyod pa sngon po/ shar gyi mtshan ma bruṃ las rnam snang dkar po/ lho'i mtshan ma aṃ las rin chen 'byung ldan ser po/ nub kyi mtshan ma dz+riṃ las 'od dpag med dmar po/ byang gi mtshan ma khaṃ las don yod grub pa ljang khu rnams rang snang ba'i yum dang bcas par gyur pa bkra shis khrus kyi bum pa brgyad po na/ khrus kyi bum pa brgyad kyi nang dang lha mtshan gyis gnas su sgo mtshams ma brgyad grub pa ni/

shar khwa gdong ma nas g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ las bum gyi nang dang mtshan ma'i dbus su/ khaṇ+ḍa ro ha sku mdog dmar po ste/ de thams cad kyang drag mo che mo cher khros pa= nas dbus na bzhugs pa'o'i bar/ khrus bum med na/ bum pa brgyad du sgo mtshams ma brgyad bskyed pa'i tshigs rnams dang*/ de thams cad kyi zhes pa'i tshigs bor bas 'grub bo/ /lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ= nas/ lha rnams rang la gnyis su med par thim/ gyi bar/ lha sta gon gyi skabs bzhin las/ rgyas byed kyi gzhug tu las bum gyi khaṇ+ḍa ro ha la 'od dpag tu med pas dbu rgyan zhes lhag por brjod/ phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ gsang mchod/ rkang brgyad kyi bstod pa rnams sgrub thabs las mchod pa'i rnal 'byor gyi skabs su bshad pa bzhin te/ 'on kyang nang mchod byin rlabs dang*/ bla ma rnams kyi mtshan smos pa dag mi dgos so/ /rdo rje dang 'brel ba'i me tog 'phreng ba nas bzung ste/ bzlas pa bya la/ de yang rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi 'phreng ba rnams/ kha dog dmar po'i tshul gyis spros pa gzungs thag la 'khril nas song ba/ lha rnams thugs kar reg pas thugs rgyud bskul/ sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/

zhes brjod la/ gtso bo yab yum gyi sngags brgya rtsa brgyad las mi nyung ba bzla/ 'khor rnams la bdun las mi nyung ba bzla ba dang*/ las bum la khaṇ+ḍa ro ha'i sngags dang*/ yi ge bdun pa rnams kyang ci rigs par bzla zhing*/ khyad par sum bha lan nyi shu rtsa gcig las mi nyung ba bzla'o/ /mthar oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/ zhes pa'ang ci rigs pa bzlas/ dung chos la dmigs nas/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta u da ka hūṃ/ zhes pa nyer gcig tsam bzlas lha sta gon gyi skabs ltar 'jig rten 'das pa'i lha la gtor ma 'bul/ gong bzhin mchod bstod bya/ yig brgya tshar gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang*/ zhes sogs nas/ bzod par gsol/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes pas mchod yon phul/ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis lha rnams 'dod chags chen po'i mes byang chub kyi sems su zhu bar gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ dge slong dā ri ka pas lha gzhan rnams zhu zhing*/ las bum gyi lha mi zhu bar 'dod kyang mtha' gcig tu de ltar mi dgos so/ /yal 'dab kyis las bum gyi chu blangs la/ thams cad la bsangs shing*/ ji srid dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du/ bgegs thams cad bsrung ba'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod do/ /cho ga cung zad bsdus pa byed na/ bum pa'i mtshan ma rnams lhar bskyed mi dgos/ gtor ma 'bul ba dang*/ bzlas pa'i rjes kyi mchod bstod kyang bor bas rung ngo*/ /da ltar gyi lag len dang bstun nas skabs 'dir rjes chog byed na/ mchod pa gsar du'ang bsham/ rnying pa gsos mchod 'phreng bzhin byin gyis rlabs/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo rnams tshigs bcad dang bcas pa'am/ bsdu na sngags tsam gyis phul/ rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod/ ma 'byor pa dang*/ sogs/ bzod par gsol/ bdag la dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ oṃ badz+ra u dhiṣ+ṭha/ zhes pa dang rdo rje shugs kyi phyag rgyas/

mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bzhugs par bsam/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo rkang brgyad rnams kyis mchod bstod bya/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams spyan ma drangs kyi bar du/ steng gi nam mkhar bzhugs la/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la thugs brtse ba chen po mdzad de/ nangs par dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod/ de nas bdag nyid bsrung ba dang smon lam dang bkra shis sogs bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ zhi bas sbyang ba dang zhi drag phyed mas sbyang ba dang*/ drag po'i sbyang ba ste bgegs sbyang ba dang*/ til sbyang gi sdig pa sbyang ba rnams sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas sta gon gyi chos bcu gsum bya ste/ bsam pa brtan dang bu ru sgrub/ /gsol btab sngags kyi che ba brjod/ /sdom bzung lhar bskyed mchod pa 'bul/ /bsrung skud khyor chu so shing dang*/ /ku sha zab mo'i chos bshad cing*/ /rmi lam brtag ste ngan na bsrung*/ zhes bya ste/ de yang slob ma rnams 'dus pa la/ sems bskyed gsal btab/ slob ma rnams kyis maṇ+ḍal phul/ de nas mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsam pa brtan po bskyed pa/ slob ma bur sgrub pa/ gsol ba btab pa/ gsang sngags la spro ba bskyed pa/ sdom pa bzung ba/ lhar bskyed pa/ mchod pa 'bul ba/ bsrung skud bcing ba/ khyor chu/ so shing*/ ku sha sbyin pa/ zab mo'i chos bshad pas spro ba bskyed pa/ rmi lam brtag cing ngan na bsrung ba ste/ chos bcu gsum las/ dang po ni slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces/ sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang*/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni 'jug bya ste/ /bsod nams 'dod pas de las gzhan/ /gzhan dag 'jig rten pha rol gnyen/ /dad pa chen po ldan pa dag /'jig rten pha rol la dmigs nas/ /blo ldan dkyil 'khor 'jug bya ste/ /'di yi 'bras bu gnyer mi bya/ /gal te 'di 'bras don gnyer na/ /'jig rten pha rol 'grub mi 'gyur/

/'jig rten pha rol la dmigs na/ /'bad pa med par 'di 'bras 'grub/ ces brjod la don yang bshad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ slob dpon gyi zhal du bcug /sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkha' nang du gnas pa/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis spyan drangs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad zhal du zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba/ rdo rje lam nas byung ste khyed rang rnams la dbang bskur bas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs te dag pa'i shel ltar gyur pa/ mkha' nang nas phyir spros te/ pad+ma'i gdan la 'khod par gyur/ zhes brjod/ gsum pa ni/ rdo rje phag mo'i mgrin 'khyud pa'i/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ / zhes slob mas lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ bzhi pa ni/ bu tshur theg pa chen po la/ khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i cho ga 'di/ khyod la yang dag bshad par bya/ / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang*/ /de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang*/ /da ltar byung ba rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa kun/ /de dag kun gyi gsang sngags kyi/ /cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas/ /dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa mtshan med brnyes/ /gsang sngags spyod pa mnyam med de/ /skyob pa dpal ldan he ru kas/ / bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa/ /dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob byas phyir/

bu yi blo gros 'di gyis shig ces brjod kyang don bshad/ lnga pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs lan gsum rjes bzlos byar gzhug ste thun mong gi sdom pa bzung ba'o/ / sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /rnal 'byor gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma/ /'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid can/ /kun la rtag tu skyabs su mchi/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo/ / byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che/ /khyad par du ni slob dpon la/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung sogs dpa' bo/ /rnal 'byor ma dang snang mdzad sogs/ /byang chub sems dpa' dpag med pa/ / thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ / che ge dus 'di nas gzung ste/ /ji srid gnyis med la gnas par/ /de yi tshangs spyod gnyis med pa/ /nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par bsrung*/ zhes lan gsum rjes bzlos kyi thun mongs ma yin pas sdom pa bzung ngo*/ /drug pa ni/ slob ma he ru ka phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i gnas gsum du bdud rtsi lnga dang sbyar ba'i dri bzang gis thig le bya zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ snying gar hūṃ sngon po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ dpral par oṃ dkar po/ yang dpral ba nas mar reg ste/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ sangs rgyas thams cad sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du thim par mos/ bdun pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+peḥhūṃ/ sogs nyer spyod lngas slob ma la mchod/ brgyad pa bsrung skud bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i srad bu dmar po/ rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum dang bcas pa/ bar chad thams cad bsrung ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ ye shes kyi srad bu phaiṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ yi ge brgya pa dang sum bha/ spel bas bzla zhing*/ skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon dang*/ bud med kyi g.yas su bcing ngo*/ /las bum gyi chus kyang gtor ma la/

rdo rje rgya graṃ du reg la go skon par mos/ dgu pa ni / oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dha sar+b+ba dharmā sar+b+ba pā paṃ ni tsā s+ya sho dha ya sarba bi kalpān a pa nā ya hūṃ/ zhes pas lan gsum khyor chu blud/ bcu pa ni/ hūṃ las byung ba'i byang chub kyi shing gi rang bzhin so shing rtse la srad bu dmar po dang me tog gi 'phreng ba bcings pa dngos grub kyi ltas brtag pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ sum bha / bzlas bzhin du sbyin/ des kyang*/ oṃ badz+ra ha sa ha zhes drang por dor la/ slob dpon gyi dngos grub lung ston no/ /bcu gcig pa ni/ hūṃ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa rtse ma nyams pa/ rmi lam mi 'khrugs pa byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum/ dhiḥ zhes ku sha chung ba g.yas dang*/ hā/ zhes che ba g.yon du gtad/ bcu gnyis pa ni/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin/ /rgya lam na ni re 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang gi mnyam med sems can don/ /mya ngan mi zla byed par nus/ /bskal pa bye ba du ma ru/ /sngon du sdig pa byas pa gang*/ /dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag zad par 'gyur yin na/ /grags pa mtha' yas bsngags brjod pa'i/ /tshul la gnas pas smos ci dgos/ /skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni/ /go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur/ /gang dag spyod pa mchog 'di la/ /blo gros brtan zhing mi g.yo na/ /sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ba yi/ /ngan 'gro de yis gcod par 'gyur/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed/ /gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa'i/ /bdag nyid chen po kun gyi ni/ /bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun/ / yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin pa/ /de phyir khyed rnams theg chen la/ /sang ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur/

/theg pa chen por cher 'byung ba'i/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ /khyed rnams der ni dong bas na/ /rang byung bskal pa chen po la/ /'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur/ / zhes brjod cing don bshad/ bcu gsum pa ni/ rmi lam dge ba'am mi dge ba/ /nangs par nga la rab tu smos/ /do nub ku sha'i sngas stan la/ /seng ge'i nyal stabs dang dge ba'i sems kyi nyol zhig /de las rmi lam gyi mtshan ma bzang ngan dag mthong bar 'gyur ro/ / zhes brjod/ slob ma rnams kyi lus la go cha gnyis dgos pa'i dmigs pa tsam byas te/ dge ba bsngos la slob ma rnams rang gnas su btang ngo*/ /slob ma'am slob dpon rmi lam mi dge ba dag byung na bzlog pa'i thabs ni/ zhing skyong mkha' 'gro thams cad la/ /gtor ma cho ga bzhin tu sbyin/ /yi ge brgya pas brtan byas shing*/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo kun tu spyad/ /dpa' bo zhal gyi sngags la sogs/ /thams cad kyang ni bzlas par bya/ /go chas bdag nyid srung ba dang*/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams la/ /gsol gdab brgyan sogs nga rgyal blangs/ /me yis las la kun brtson pas/ /bgegs rnams thams cad zhi bar bya/ zhes bshad par bya'o/ /de yang gtor ma sbyin pa/ yig brgya bzla ba/ bsrung 'khor sgom pa/ las thams cad pa bzla ba/ go cha gsum bsgom pa/ lha la gsol ba gdab pa/ rgyan byin gyis rlabs pa/ rang lha'i nga rgyal bsgom pa/ bdag 'jug gi dbang blang ba/ sbyin sreg byed pa ste bcu po de dag las ji ltar 'os par sbyar ro/ /lnga pa thig gdab pa la thog mar phur pa bskyed chog mchod pa gong bzhin dang*/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs gong bzhin 'bul/ de nas thig gi cho ga dngos ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa la sum bha bzlas pa'i dri bzang gi chu'i gtor/ rang dang grogs gtso bo yab yum du gsal bas/ lnga lnga nyi shu rtsa lnga dang ldan pa'i thig skud 'dus byas la/

mchod gtor gyis bskor/ mchod pa byin gyis rlabs/ thig skud bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dbus su hūṃ las mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas yum mā ma ki la 'khyud pa/ shar du bh+ruṃ las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma la 'khyud pa/ byang du aṃ las rin chen 'byung ldan ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rin chen sgrol ma la 'khyud pa/ nub tu dz+riṃ las 'od dpag med dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum gos dkar mo la 'khyud pa/ lhor khaṃ las don yod grub pa ljang khu ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum dam tshig sgrol ma 'khyud pa/ snam snang zla ba dang gzhan rnams nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ rigs lnga ni stag gi pags pa'i smad dkris can ral pa'i thor tshugs dang ldan pa'o/ /yum rnams sku mdog yab dang mtshungs shing gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dbu skra grol ba'o/ /thams cad kyang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ yig gi 'od zer gyis nas/ ye shes sems dpa' rigs lnga yab yum gyi rnam par phaiṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs nas/ hūṃ bruṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ/ oṃ a kā ro sa ོgas kyis gtor ma phul/ ar+ghaṃ= nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ de nyid lnga pa'am rigs lnga'i bstod pa gang yang rung bas bstod/ de la de nyid lnga pa ni/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ / rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal mchog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri med mkha'/

/rang bzhin dag pa gos pa med/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dngos nyid dag pa nyid las byung*/ /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces pa'o/ / rigs lnga yab yum zhu ba las byung ba'i thig skud rnam pa lngar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥbh+ruṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥ.aṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥdz+riṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥkhaṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa dang*/ gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po ci rigs pa'i byin gyis rlabs/ yang*/ oṃ traṃ khaṃ hūṃ zhes pa rnams sa bon du byas te gtor sngags dang byin rlabs kyi sngags sogs la'ang de'i rigs 'gre'o/ /de nas ye shes kyi thig lnga tshan du bsgril la snying po bzla'o/ /las thig ni/ byin rlabs de dang mtshungs pa'am/ las thams cad pa'i lhar bskyed kyang rung ste/ khrag chen gyis spags la gsum sgril du bsgril/ bdud rtsi lnga dang tsan+dan gyis byugs/ 'bru gsum dang hūṃ yig gcig pus byin gyis brlab bo/ /

oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya su tra ma ti kra ma hūṃ/ zhes bzla zhing grogs la gtad la/ dz+dzaḥdz+dzaḥdz+dzaḥ zhes brjod/ 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i dus ni 'di yin no/ / zhes bsam/ ma lus 'jig rten khams bzhugs pa'i/ sangs rgyas la sogs khyed rnams kyis/ /'gro don mdzad pa'i dus 'di ni/ /lags pas de phyir 'dir byon cig / ces dang por nam mkha' dang de nas sa la gdab bo/ /de yang byang lho nub shar tshangs thig ste/ me rlung srin dbang zur thig go /rtse mo can dang 'byung pos shar/ /gtsug phud can dang mtshan rgyus lho/ /g.yo byed bsrung bas nub kyi ste/ /rta dmar drags po byang du'o/ /g.yon nas brtsams pa'i bskor ba dang*/ /slob ma'i slob dpon rgyab mi phyogs/ / rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la ni/ shin tu go skabs mi bde na ma gtogs/ 'jig rten lho la dkyil 'khor gyi shar bstan par bya la/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la ni nges pa med do/ /de nas phyogs thams cad rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid du shes par bya'o/ /de nas las thig gdab pa la/ dkyil 'khor spyi'i mtshan nyid gzhan du rtogs par bya la/ nang gi cha ni dge slong dā ri ka pas/ tshangs pa'i thig gi ngos rer yang re re lngar bya nyi shu gdab/ pho brang la gnyis ge sar gcig /gsum gsum gyi ni 'khor lo rnams/ /ka ba gri gug rdo rje'i 'phreng*/ /pad+ma 'khor lo re rer bya/ /gcig gi phyi ma'i khyams yin te/ /ces pa ltar tshangs thig nas rtsa thig gi bar la cha chen bzhi yod pa re re yang*/ lnga tshan lnga tshan du bkod/ pad+ma'i snying po la gnyis/ 'khor lo bzhi la gsum gsum/ ge sar dang 'phreng ba bzhi la re re/ lha rnams la gcig go /yang na ge sar gyi dod 'dab ma la snon par bshad kyang*/ de'i dod lha rnams la bsnan na legs te/ yang na 'jigs med 'byung gnas zhabs kyis grub chen lū yi pa'i dgongs pa bskang ba ltar btab kyang rung la/

rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa lā ba pas mdzad pa nas bshad pa'i thig gi rnam bzhag kyang lū yi pa'i lugs 'di dang 'brel chags pa yin pas de dag gsum po gang rung zhig dang mthun par gdab bo/ dur khrod ni bsrung 'khor gyi phyi nang gang yang rung bar te/ rdo rje'i ra ba'i nang du 'bri na cha chen gcig yin la/ phyi rol du 'bri na tshad nges pa med do/ /rta babs yang sgo'i tshad gsum 'gyur dang*/ sgo tshad gcig la sogs pa dang snam bu yang bzhi dang brgyad dang bcu gcig la sogs pa tshad dang ldan pa'i lugs gcig dang mthun na gang yang 'gal ba med do/ /de nas thig gi lha la mchod bstod phul/ oṃ āḥhūṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes gshegs su gsol/ skabs 'dir mig tu hī bkod la sgo'i rtsa thig phyi/ 'on kyang 'di bskor gyi gzhung thun mong ma yin pa rnams nas/ sgo'i rtsa thig dbyibs ma gsungs pas/ ma byas kyang chog par mngon no/ /drug pa rdul tshon dbye ba ni/ rdul mtshon lnga'am nyi shu rtsa lnga 'dus byas la/ mchod gtor gyis bskor/ mchod pa byin rlabs nas/ gtso bo yab yum gyi snying pos byin gyis rlabs pa'i bar/ thig skud byin rlabs dang 'dra ba las/ rdul mtshon rnam pa lngar gyur/ zhes 'dod pa spo/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūṃ/ zhes lan brgya rtsa brgyad kyis byin gyis brlabs/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su kha lhor phyogs pas gnas te/ 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni sgrol byed pa/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung rgyal po nyid/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /nyes pa kun las rnam grol ba/ /tshon gyi las ni yang dag brtsam/ ces brjod/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūṃ/ gi sngags bzla zhing*/ rtsig pa dkar po nas brtsams te/ bri bar bya'o/ /tshon gyi kha dog ni phal cher dkyil 'khor spyi'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan rtogs pas shes par 'gyur la/ lha rnams kyi phyogs mdog shar dkar lho ser sogs yin la/

thugs 'khor gyi gzhi ljang khu/ gsung 'khor gyi dkar po/ sku 'khor gyi dmar po bshad pa'ang yod la/ yang de gsum rim can du sngo dkar dmar bar mdzad pa'ang yod de/ de gnyis ka'ang rgyud so so'i dgongs pa'o/ /'dod snam yang dmar po dang ser po dang dkar po ji ltar bris kyang rung*/ bde chen 'khor lo'i mu khyud ser po dang*/ gri gug gi 'phreng ba sngon po'o/ /rdo rje ra ba yang gzhi sngon po la rdo rje ljang khu'i 'phreng bar bya'o/ /lha'i mtshan ma ni/ gtso bo'i gnas su rdo rje dang gri gug gam/ thod pa la gnas pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la'o/ /phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi dang sgo mtshams ma brgyad la yang gri gug ste brgyad po ni mi ro'i gdan la'o/ /mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la ni bum thod do/ /thugs kyi rtsibs brgyad la rdo rje gri gug re'o/ /gsung gi brgyad la pad+ma dang gri gug go /sku'i brgyad la 'khor lo dang gri gug go /yang na gtso bo'i gnas dang thugs 'khor lo rdo rje/ gsung la pad+ma/ sku la 'khor lo/ rnal 'byor ma bcu gnyis la gri gug go /yang na 'khor lo gsum la rdo rje dang gri gug 'ba' zhig go /gzhan yang gcig tu gtso bo'i gnas su rdo rje dang*/ lhag ma rnams la gri gug go /'ga' zhig las ni phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi la rigs bzhi'i phyag mtshan gyis mtshan pas kha ṭ+waṃ ga re re'o/ /gzhan dag ni gri gug sum cu rtsa bdun zhes kyang 'dod do/ /de thams cad la mi rung ba med par mngon no/ /de bzhin du sa bon dang sngags kyi yi ge 'bri ba dang lugs su byas pa dang ri mor bris pa'i sku gzugs 'jog pa dang*/ rdul tshon gyi tshom bu dang gdan gyi rnam par dgod pa sogs kyang*/ ji ltar skabs su bab pa dag bya'o/ /de nas slob dpon gyis rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu dkrol la dkyil 'khor la g.yon nas lan gsum du bskor nas/ shar lhor yi ge brgya pa dang zhal bzhi pa'i sngags bzlas nas/

bris kyi skyon dag par bsam mo/ /rdul mtshon gyi lhag ma la mchod bstod gshegs gsol bya/ lhag ma'i thig tshon de dag dben pa'i gnas su bzhag go/bdun pa/ rgyan dang yo byad dgod pa ni/ bkra shis kyi bum pa brgyad/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad du dgos pa la/ de dag tu mi bde na rdo rje'i ra ba'i nang gi phyogs mtshams brgyad du'o/ /rnam rgyal bum pa la ni gtso ba'i gnas su 'god cing*/ 'dir yang der mi bde na shar gyi bum pa'i nang tshan du dgod par bya'o/ /las bum ni 'jig rten gyi lho dkyil 'khor chen po'i shar sgo'i g.yon logs su 'god do/ /bum pa rnams kyi steng du rin po che dang bza' ba sna tshogs kyis bkang ba'i thod pa bzhag go /gzhan yang j-i skad du/ me tog spos dang mar me dang*/ /dri dang bza' ba rol mo dang*/ / gos dang ku sha rgyan la sogs/ /nye 'khor du ni dgod par bya/ /chang dang sha rlon gtor ma dang*/ / 'du ba yi ni rdzas rnams kun/ /de yis phyi rol dag tu bzhag /dar dang bla bre gdugs dang ni/ / rgyal mtshan rnams kyis gnas brgyan te/ khrag 'thung cha lugs 'dzin pa yis/ /sgo gsum bzhi ni bzhag par bya/ zhes pa ltar/ bum pa 'bul ba'i skabs rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gcig gam gsum byas nas/ bum pa gzhan rnams so so'i gnas su 'jog rnam rgyal bum pa ni gtso 'khor thams cad kyi sngags bzlas bzhin du/ so so'i gnas su 'jog tshul tsam byas nas/ mthar dbus sam shar phyogs su 'jog pa lag len du mdzad kyin snang bas spros pa la dga' na de ltar bya la/ 'on kyang gzhung nas bshad pa ma mthong ste/ mdor bsdus pa'i tshe ma byas kyang chog go /brgyad pa dkyil 'khor sgrub pa ni/ gong du bshad pa ltar/ sngon 'gro gtor ma nas bdag bskyed rdzogs pa'i bar bsgoms nas/ dkyil 'khor la dmigs te sbyang ba gsum byed dgos pa las/ bgegs gtor bsangs sbyangs/

'bru gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs/ gtor ma'am mtheb kyu gsum po rim gyis bskor la/ oṃ sarba bigh+nān bh+yaḥ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yeḥ sarba thā khaṃ ud ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ/ gṛh+ṇa dam ba liṃ te swāhā/ zhes lan gsum/ 'dir bgegs kyis tshogs gang yin pa thams cad/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'dis tshim nas/ phan pa dang bde ba'i sems ldan pas gzhan du dengs shig zhi bas sbyang ba'o/ / oṃ sum bha sogs lan gsum bzlas shing rdo rje gsor la/ ting lo'am chang bu skor/ 'dir bgegs kyi tshogs gang yin pa de thams cad/ gtor ma lam rngan ting lo lam sgron/ chang bu lam rgyags kyi tshul du khyer la/ sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du songs shig ces pas ni zhi drag phyed mas sbyangs pa'o/ /hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya byas nas bden stobs brjod la mthar drag po'i mtshams rngams rol chen dang bcas pas skrad pa ni/ 'di ltar/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ yi dam rgyal ba dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong bsrung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bden pa dang*/ kun rdzob rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ 'dir dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub cing mchod pa dang dbang gi las la 'jug pa la/ bar du gcod par byed pa'i 'byung po gdon bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa de dag /deng dpal he ru ka'i bka' thos pas sa'i phyogs 'dir gnas par myur ba nyid du songs shig /gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag thams cad dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i/

khro bo'i rdo rje dang rdo rje kha ṭ+waṃ ga 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba 'dis/ khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar gas par bya'o/ / zhes bgegs bskrad cing gtor ma phyir dor/ drag pos sbyangs pa'o/ /dge slong dā ri ka pas/ bgegs la gtor ma sbyin byas te/ /zhal bzhi pa'i sngags bzlas shing*/ chang bu dang ni mar mes sbyangs/ gu gul yung dkar gyis bgegs la/ zhes bshad bgegs sbyang ba gsum mo/ /bsdus pa la mos na/ bka' bsgo ba yid kyis byas nas sngags tsam brjod do/ / bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad snying gar yi ge baṃ gyi rnam par gnas pa/ lte ba'i gtum mo 'bar ba'i 'od kyis ded de/ sna sgor sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par gyur pa mdun gyi til la thim/ bsangs sbyangs/ 'bar ba'i me nang du khro bo rdo rje mkha' 'gro rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa zhal gdangs pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ḍa ka kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmi ku ru swāhā/ lan gsum brjod/ las kyi rdo rje til g.yas g.yon du bskor nas/ g.yas su me dang g.yon du chu dor bas rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i zhal du gsol ba dang*/ rgya mtsho chen por bsgyur bar bsam/ mthar me yang chu nang du lugs so/ /sdig pa spyad pa'o/ /de nas me long bstan te/ las bum blangs nas khrus gsol bya ste/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam nas/ shri ye hūṃ/ 'di ni khrus mchog sogs dang*/ de bzhin gshegs dang*/ sogs rol chen dang*/ bcas pas kyang khrus gsol/ de dag sku la nas/ oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hriḥ.aḥkā ya bi shwadha na ye swāhā/ zhes sku phyis phul/ spro na dri'i byug pa dang*/ gos brgyan yang 'bul te/ dri ma sbyangs pa'o/ /de nas bar 'dir phur bu gsal btab nas mchod pa 'bul ba sta gon gyi skabs bzhin/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs/ oṃ shūn+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/

oṃ a ni mi ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ a pra ṇi hi ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes rnam thar sgo gsum gyi don bsam mo/ / stong pa'i ngang las/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po= nas/ lcog brgyad dang ldan pa/ de'i rtse mor bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su nas gang ba'o/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i dbus kyi lte ba rang nyid hūṃ yig gi rnam par gnas par gyur/ de las 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phros/ 'khor los lnga'i= zhes pa nas/ rjes chags kyis zhu ba hūṃ yig la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs yongs su rdzogs pa ni/ bde chen 'khor lo'i dbus kyi lte bar 'khor lo bde mchog= nas me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i 'dab ma brgyad la/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma= nas rdo rje 'phreng ba'i mtshan pa'o/ /yab kyi snying gar oṃ ha dkar po rdo rje sems dpa' nas nyi ma'i 'od can no/ /lha thams cad kyi dpral par oṃ nas dbang gi lha thams cad rang la gnyis su med par thim gyi bar lha sta gon gyi skabs dang 'dra/ slar yang rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ yig gi 'od zer gyis/ sta gon gyi lha rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad spyan drangs par gyur phaiṃ/ sum+bha/ lan gcig bzlas shing rdo rje gsor/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo rnams kyis mchod/ rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ lan mang du brjod/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharmā yo ga shud+dho3 haṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /sgrub mchod zhag sbrel ma byed na/ dngos gzhi nyi ma gnyis pa phan chad la/ sta gon gyi lha spyan 'dren 'di mi dgos so/ /de nas byin rlabs drug skor du grags pa/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlabs pa'i bzlas pa ste/ kha cig mchod pa'i rjes su bzlas pa byed par 'dod pa yang yod do/ /mchod pa lan gcig las mi byed na/

mchod pa'i sngon du bzlas pa bya la/ gnyis byed na gnyis kyi bar du byas pas legs par 'gyur ro/ /gang ltar yang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo las/ he ru ka gnyis pa zhig chad nas/ bzlas pa dang mchod pa byed cing bdag 'jug len pa yin la/ las kyi rdo rje lho phyogs su 'dug la/ dbyugs gu'i sna la rdo rje btags pas/ lha so so'i gnas su gnod pa med par reg cing*/ sngags mchod bzhin lha thams cad kyi snying po tshar gcig brjod/ bum thod kyi gnas su 'bru gsum brjod de dang po'o/ /'dir re re bzhin mang du bzlas na legs so/ /de nas lha thams cad la yum gyi nye snying bzla ste gnyis pa'o/ /oṃ ka ka s+ya/ u lu ka s+ya/ shwa na s+ya/ su ka rā s+ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pa'am sgo mtshams ma brgyad char gyi sngags bzla ste/ gsum pa'o/ / oṃ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes bzla ste bzhi pa'o/ /oṃ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa'ang bzla ste lnga pa'o/ /lha so so'i mtshan dang spel ba'i yi ge brgya pa'am/ de ma lcogs na/ he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa nyid/ lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi gnas su sbyar bas chog ste drug pa'o/ /byin rlabs bzlas pa 'di'i thog mthar/

ar+ghaṃ= nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod pa re dang rkang brgyad kyi bstod pa re bya/ mthar/ bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyis bdag la dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab la me tog dor/ bum pa la dmigs nas/ sta gon gyi skabs su bstan pa ltar so so'i sngags brgya rtsa la sogs pa'i ji ltar 'os pa bzla'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ nag po zhabs lugs kyi dkyil mchog tu bshad pa ltar/ mchod pa byin rlabs nas brtsam ste mchod pa mtha' dag 'bul zhing*/ ci ste bsdus pa la mngon par dga' bas kyang*/ bstod pa ma gtogs tshigs bcad rnams dor te/ sngags dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gsum 'dzoms pa'i sgo nas/ lhag ma mtha' dag ma tshang ba med par bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu gtor ma 'bul ba yang bya ste/ sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa bzhin no/ /phyi rol gtor ma thun mong ma yin pas gzhung rnying pa rnams nas ma bshad pas/ nges par dgos pa yang ma yin la/ lag len la yang mi mdzad pa shas che zhing*/ ci ste byed par spro na/ phyi rol gtor ma/ skor ba/ me tog 'bul ba/ sgo dbye ba/ gsol gdab rnams/ rdo rje 'phreng ba nas 'byung ba ltar bya'o/ /sgrub mchod zhag mang por sbrel ba'i skabs/ dngos gzhi nyi ma gnyis pa phan chad la/ skabs 'dir bum sgrub sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar/ cho ga rgyas par byed pa'i lag len snang ba/ 'dir bum pa sgrub pa'i nyi ma rnams la/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i skabs su bum bzlas mi dgos so/ /dgu pa bdag nyid 'jug pa ni/ gzhung tha dad nas rgyas bsdus sna tshogs bshad kyang*/ slob ma ji tsam bskur ba de tsam rdzogs par len pa da ltar lag len byed do/ /de yang rang nyid gtso bo'i mdun zhal gyi sgo dang nye ba'i 'dug cing gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i he ru ka phyag gnyis pas las mdzad par dmigs la/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/

bdag nyid rnam par snang mdzad du gyur/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las yang dag byung*/ /de bzhin de nyid nges par 'byung*/ /bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor ni/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams/ /kun gyi dri med mthong bar shog lan gsum/ rdo rje phag mos mgrin 'khyud pa'i/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ oṃ tsak+ṣur ban+dha ba ra ma na ya hūṃ/ gis mig dar bcing*/ ā khaṃ bī ra hūṃ/ gis me tog bzung*/ las bum gyi chus gtor la/ sum+bha bgegs bskrad/ dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūṃ gis srung bar bya/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'/ zhes dris pa la/ skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o/ / zhes lan btab/ slar yang*/ de yis bu la ci zhig bya/ zhes dris pa la/ sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go / zhes lan btab/ rang gi snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'i rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od 'phro ba/ kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i byang chub sems kyi bdag nyid do/ /oṃ badz+ra yo ga tsit+ta u pa da ya mi/ rdo rje snying gar gtad/ su ra ta sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ ho sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ rdo rje mgo bor bzhag la/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis rlabs par 'gyur gyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no/ / dkyil 'khor khang pa'am yol ba'i nang du bcug par mos la/ hūṃ dza hūṃ/ zha ེsa brjod/ de yan chad ni dkyil chog gi rtsa ba'i gzhung na mi gsal yang*/ dkyil chog gi gzhung phyi ma rnams las 'byung zhing*/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi man ngag gis kha skangs pa'i phyag len no/ /'di man chad 'jug pa'i chos ni 'di ltar/

/sdom pa mdor bstan dam rdzas sbyin/ /srung ba dpa' bo bskul ba dang*/ /gsol ba gdab cing gnang ba zhu/ /phyag 'tshal sdom pa sbyin pa dang*/ /dam la bzhag cing ye shes phab/ /nam mkha'i mdog dri me tog phul/ /mig dar phye la lta bar bskul/ /lha ngo bstan zhing de nyid brjod/ /ces bya'o/ /de ltar don tshan bcu drug las/ dang po sdom pa mdor bstan ni/gong nas gong ma'i sdom pa ni/ /bu khyod kyis ni bzung bya ste/ /grol ba'i rgyu ni de las gzhan/ /thabs ni ci yang yod ma yin/ zhes so/ gnyis pa dam rdzas sbyin pa ni/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum sogs bzla bzhin du/ bdud rtsi myang zhing lus la gtor/ gsum pa bsrung ba sbyin pa ni/ rang nyid 'khor lo bde mchog zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur gsal ba'i/ snying gar oṃ ha dkar po nas/ nyi ma'i 'od can no/ /spyi bo la sogs pa'i nas na si ma ku/ khams rnams dpa' bo dang rtsa rnams dpa' mo'i bdag nyid du gyur/ bzhi pa dpa' mo bskul ba ni/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad he ru ka'i rnam par spyan drangs/ rang gi snying gar thim pas mi shigs pa dpyid kyi rtsa thig dpal he ru ka zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ oṃ shrī he ru ka bid ma he bid+yā rā dzā ya/ dhiḥm he swāhā/ zhes lan lnga'am/ bdun no/ /lnga pa gsol ba gdab pa ni/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*/ /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo/ /rnal 'byor gnas la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /don dam smra ba'i seng ge zhes bya ba/ /nyon mongs gcod pa'i don la shin tu mkhas gyur par/ /srid pa'i nyes brgya skyed rtsa nyon mongs chom mdzod la/ /rnal 'byor don dam rgyal po de nyid 'grub par mdzod/

ces lan gsum/ drug pa gnang ba zhu ba ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ / lan gsum/ bdun pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ gnas gsum du thal mo sbyor bzhin pas/ oṃ na ma ste hūṃ/ na mā me hūṃ/ na mo na maḥhūṃ swāhā/ zhes lan gsum mo/ /brgyad pa sdom pa sbyin pa la sgrags bzung gnyis las/ sgrags pa ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song*/ /'di ni sangs rgyas rig yid 'ong*/ /sdom pa brtan por gyur pa'o/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya ni/ /blo chen khyod kyis bzung bar bya/ /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ /shes rab dril bu zhes bsgrags so/ /slob dpon khyod kyis bzung bar bya/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /'di ni rdo rje'i rig dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par bshad/ /rin chen rigs la rtag tu ni/ /nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu/ /chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs byams/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pas chos ni ma lus bzung*/ /'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba'o/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ / mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /zhes so/ / gnyis pa sdom pa bzung ba ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs lan gsum gyis thun mong gi sdom pa bzung*/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /dam pa bdag gi bskyed par bgyi/

/tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*/ /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*/ /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas brtan por bzung*/ /rdo rje rig mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ / slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rig mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs can dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni bzung bar bgyi/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /dam pa dag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gi sdom pa ma lus bzung*/ /ma brgal ba rnams sgral bar bgyi/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /dbugs ma phyin la dbugs dbyung zhing*/ /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ / ces pa lan gsum gyis rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung*/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ zhes pa nas/ nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par bzung gi bar na gsum/ slob ma lta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar gyi rgyud rgyal 'di nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pas sdom pa bzung bar bzhed do/ /de dag ni sdom bzung rgyas pa'i lugs yin la/ 'bring du na phyi ma gcig pus chog cing*/ bsdus pa ni/ gtso bo'i ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bgyid par 'tshal/ lan gsum/ /dgu pa dam la bzhag pa ni/ deng khyod dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ /ngas khyod la dpal he ru ka'i ye shes bskyed par bya ste/

ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang*/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na dngos grub gzhan lta ci zhig smos/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ zhes phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag rdo rje snying gar reg ste/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur/ /gal te tshul 'di smras gyur na/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /thod pa nas bdud rtsi'i chu btung la/ /'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis thob/ /oṃ pañca a mṛ ta u ta ka ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥhūṃ/ zhes dam tshig bsrung ba'i phan yon dang ma bsrung ba'i nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag deng nas brtsams te bu khyod kyi dpal he ru ka nga yin gyis/ gang ngas 'd-i byos zhes bsgo ba de bya dgos so/ /khyod kyis nga la brnyas par yang ma byed cig khyod mi bde ba ma spangs par dus byas nas dmyal bar lhung bar 'gyur ta re/ zhes slob dpon gyi bka'/ nyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag bcu pa ye shes dbab pa ni/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi byin gyis rlobs shigadapal he ru ka bdag la dbab par mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ rang he ru ka phyag gnyis par gyur pa/ g.yas brkyang gi zhabs gnyis kyi 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon mo zla gam g.yo ba'i ba dan dang bcas pa/ rkang mthil gnyis su yi ge dzhaiṃ ljang khu/ sum mdor raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ snying gar laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po la rdo rje dang hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ mgrin par baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po la bum pa dang as mtshan pa/ spyi bor yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam nag po la has mtshan pa/

rkang mthil gyi 'og gi dzhaiṃ phul/ des sum mdo'i me sbar/ des snying ga'i sa bsregs/ des mgrin pa'i chu skol ba snying ga'i sa la thim pas bde bas gang*/ rkang mthil gyi rlung dang mes nam mkha' la bteg /spyi bo'i rlung gis mar phul bas 'dar yed yed gnas pa la/ nam mkha' nas lus kyi stod kyi cha la thugs kyi 'khor lo pa rnams nag po'i rnam pas thim/ bar gyi cha la gsung gi 'khor lo pa rnams dmar po'i rnam pas thim/ smad kyi cha la sku'i 'khor lo pa rnams dkar po'i rnam pas 'jug cing*/ de ma yin pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dpag tu med pa yang ba spu'i bu ga nas zhugs shing snying gar thim par gyur/ yab yum gyi snying po dang*/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī badz+ra ā be sha ya staṃ bha ya ra ra ra ra tsa la ya tsa la ya hūṃ haḥ.aḥdzhaiṃ/ ces pa'i dbab cing*/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha mahā kro dha ā be sha ya hūṃ/ oṃ shrī he ru kā ya bid ma he bid+yā rā dza yadhi ma he swāhā/ zhes pa'ang bzla ste rol mo'i sgra dang bcas dbab bo/ /spyir 'khor lo sdom pa'i dbang la/ ye shes 'bebs pa'i sngags phyi ma 'di gnyis yin kyang*/ 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor bkod pa 'di byas phyin/ sngags snga ma yang bzlas na legs te sngags 'di dang 'brel ba'i dmigs pa yin pas so/ / tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag bcu gcig pa nam mkha'i kha dog dri ba ni 'dir mi dgos kyang*/ slob ma dbang bskur ba'i skabs yin na dgos te/ skabs 'dir nam mkha'i kha dog dri zhim las bzhi lung bstan/ bcu gnyis pa me tog dor ba ni/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra ho/ zhes me tog dor/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa dam i maṃ satwa mahā pa la/ zhes me tog spyi bor bcings/ bcu gsum pa mig dar dbye ba ni/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong bar gyur/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/

/oṃ badz+ra ne tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hriḥ zhes mig dar bsal/ bcu bzhi pa lta bar bskul ba ni/ ltos shig ltos shig sems dpa' che/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis rlobs/ / 'gro ba phun sum tshogs kun dang*/ /dngos grub kun khyod dbang bskur gyur/ / dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang*/ /sngags rnams la yang brtson par gyis/ bco lnga pa lha ngo bstan pa ni/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad mngon sum bzhin du gsal bar gyur/ zhes brjod cing*/ yid kyis dkyil 'khor gsal btab/ slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i don du ni sgrub thabs ltar lha ngo rgyas pa bstan dgos so/ /bcu drug pa de kho na nyid brjod pa ni/ gzhal med khang ni byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun yin la/ lha sum cu rtsa bdun de rnams rnam par dag pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das nas dpal he ru ka yab yum ni/ brtan g.yo thams cad kyi bdag nyid chos kyi dbyings yin la/ 'khor lo lnga'i lha tshogs ni ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid do/ / zhes brjod cing don bsam pa'o/ /de nas dbang gi dngos gzhi la/ thog mar rdo rje slob ma'i dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/

he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba/ / 'gro ba skyobs pa'i gzi brjid can/ /ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnas rtsal/ /de bzhin bdag la deng stsol cig ces lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ /de nas dang por sngags kyi dbang bskur ba ni/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra ho/ zhes me tog dor/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'phreng ba byung bdag gi snying gar thim/ gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po tshar gsum rjes bzlos byas par mos/ spro na lha thams cad kyi snying po tshar gsum gsum dang*/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi/ /bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ lan gsum/ spyi bor me tog bzhag la/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ /bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ lan gsum mo/ /de nas bdag dang dbang rdzas thams cad la/ las bum gyi chus bsangs shing*/ sum bha brjod do/ /rig pa'i dbang lnga las chu dbang ni/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ bdag dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu gnyis ka mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las/ gnyis ka'ang mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po g.yas rdo rje dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang*/ thod pa'i 'phreng ba'i cod pan can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ yum mā ma ki sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'am/ g.yas brkyang gi bzhugs pa/ dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' mi bskyod pa yab yum spyan drangs phaiṃ/ dza hūṃ baṃ hoḥ slar yang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor phaiṃ/ puṣ+pe/ sogs kyis mchod/ khyed rnams kyis 'di la dbang bskur du gsol/

zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a ṣiñca hūṃ/ zhes dbang rdzas la dbang bskur sku gang*/ dri ma dgachu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chur gyur/ dkyil 'khor pa rnams dang*/ dbang gi lha gtso bos dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ sgo mtshams ma rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ dpa' bo rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ dpa' mo rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu blangs/ dbang gi lha'i 'khor gzhan rnams kyis rol mo'i sgra sgrags/ me tog gi char phab ste shis pa brjod par gyur/ skabs 'dir bram ze rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor bkra shis brjod pa'i phyag len snang zhing*/ bsdu na ma byas kyang chog / oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ sogs/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis tshigs bcad gsum dang*/ nyin mo bde legs/ sogs brjod/ rol chen bya/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhais gsol ba btab/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sgo mtshams ma brgyad sprul/ bkra shis kyi bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis= nas khrus kyi bgyi'o/ oṃ kā ka s+yā/ u lu kā s+yā shwa na s+yā/ su ka ra s+yā/ ya ma ḍa ḍhi/ ya ma dū ti/ ya ma daṣ+ti ni/ ya ma mā tha ni ye/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ de nas dbang gi lha rdo rje phag mo snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang bcas pas/ ḍā ma ru dang bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod par rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu dang bcas pa thogs nas/ dbang bskur rol mo bde chen po zhes pa nas/ sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he sogs snying po'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca/ zhes pas dbang bskur ro/ /bkra shis bum pa brgyad logs su med na/ cho gas rim pa sngar ltar las/

dang po la rnam rgyal nas bum chu gtor ba tsam bya zhing*/ gnyis pa la bum pa nyid dam bum chu thod par blug nas dbang bskur ba gang bde bya'o/ / de ltar bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu rgyan/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer gyi/ mi bskyod pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ ba sbu'i bu ga nas zhugs pas/ lus thams cad mi bskyod pa'i rdul phra rab kyis gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de ltar na chus dbang thob/ zhe sdang dag rnam shes gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa'i bag chags dang sa bon nus pa mthu can du byas pa yin no/ /cod pan gyi dbang ni/ swa bhā wa/ bdag dang dbang rdzas rin po che'i dbu rgyan gnyis ka mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du £© aṃ las rin po che aṃ= rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po g.yas rin po che dang*/ g.yon de'i= yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo gri gug= dpral par oṃ= ye shes sems dpa' rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum spyan drangs phaiṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ dbang rdzas la/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag/chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu rgyan/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i rin po che'i dbu rgyan du gyur/ khyed rnams kyis bdag nas/ gsol zhes gsol btab pas/ ma mo brgyad kyi= ral pa'i thor tshugs kyis brgyan pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa yi/ /rin chen dbu rgyan dam pa dang*/ /dar dpyangs dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /oṃ sarba bud+dha ṭa ki nī/ sogs yum gyi snying po'i dbu rgyan dang dar dpyangs dang bcas pa bcings/ oṃ ka kā s+yā/ sogs dang gtso bo'i snying po brjod/

mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis rin chen 'byung ldan dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ ba spu'i bu ga nas zhugs pas lus thams cad rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rdul phra rab kyis gang bar gyur/ mchod pa lngas mchod/ de ltar nang dbu rgyan gyi dbang thob/ nga rgyal dang ser sna dag /tshor ba gnas gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi bag chags sa bon nus pa mthu can du byas pa yin no/ / de bzhin du 'og ma gsum la'ang cod pan gyi dbang gis rigs 'gre ste/ rdo rje'i dbang ni/ dz+riṃ las pad+ma bi badz+ri= 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po/ pad+ma dang = yum gos dkar mo dmar mo/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /he ru ka dpal dbang bskur bas/ /de ring khyod la dbang bskur te/ /rab tu sgrub phyir rdo rje long*/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñca mi tiṣ+ṭha bī ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis 'od dpag med dpag tu med pa/ lus thams cad 'od dpag tu med pa'i rdul= de ltar na rdo rje'i= 'dod chags= 'du shes= so sor rtog pa'i ye shes= 'od dpag med pa'i zhes 'don pa spo'o/ /dril bu'i dbang ni/ khaṃ las ral gri khaṃ= don yod grub pa ljang khu= ral gri dang*/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang khu= 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyis/ shes rab dbyangs kyis rjes 'gror bshad/ khyed kyis kyang ni rtag tu bshad/ byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis don yod grub pa dpag tu med pa/ don yod grub pa'i rdul/ dril bu'i dbang*/ phrag dog= 'du byed= bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes= don yod grub pa'i/ zhes 'don pa spo'o/ /ming gi dbang ni/ 'di la dbang rdzas med pas/ bdag nyid mi dmigs te= zhes bya zhing*/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du/ bruṃ las 'khor lo bruṃ= rnam par snang mdzad dkar po= 'khor lo dang*/

yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo/ dbang rdzas la dbang bskur ba dang*/ dbang rdzas kyi lha zhu ba mi dgos pas/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ khyed rnams kyis bdag la/ zhes sbrel bas chog oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ shrī he ru ka nā maḥ.a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kyai dpal gsang mtshan dran par bya/ oṃ kā ka s+yā/ sogs dang gtso bo'i snying po brjod/ sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis/ rnam par snang mdzad dpag tu med pa/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi rdul= de ltar na ming gi dbang*/ gti mugagazugs phung chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi zhes 'don pa spo'o/ /dbang de rnams thob pas bya ba spyod pa'i rgyud nyan pa dang bshad pa dang sngags sgrub la dbang ngo*/ /spang bya ma rig pa lnga spong zhing*/ rig pa ye shes lnga skye'o/ /brtul zhugs kyi dbang la gnyis las thun mong ba rdo rje'i brtul zhugs ni/ swa bha wa/ stong pa'i ngang las bdag nyid mi bskyod pa nas bzhugs pa'i bar gong bzhin/ rang gi snying gar yang rang dang 'dra ba'i mi bskyod pa/ thugs rdo rje ngo bo rdo rje/ deng phyin chad tha mal gyi spyod pa rdul la rdo rje sems dpa'i tshul la zhugs shig 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /he ru ka dpal phyag na gnas/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcangs/ /he ru ka dpal brtul zhugs brtan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa s+t+waṃ dhar ya mi hūṃ ha ha ha ha ho/ zhes brjod cing rdo rje gnas gsum du reg la snying gar bzhag go /thun mong ma yin pa spyod pa'i brtul zhugs ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis 'khor lo bde mchog zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa'i skur gyur/ rang gi snying gar yang rang dang 'dra ba'i he ru ka hūṃ las byung ba'i cang te'u/ thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /tshangs skud rnams su gyur/ he ru ka dpal phyag rgya 'di/ phyi dang nang du yang dag gnas/ kha ṭ+wāṃ cang te'u lhung zed dag

/sbyin pa dpa' bos bzung bar gyis/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang ḍā ma ru/ /he ru ka dpal kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /rnal 'byor ma ni ḍā ma ru/ /rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ rdo rjer bcas/ /dril bu sil sil sgra sgrogs shing*/ /tshangs pa'i skud thogs rnal 'byor bdag kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang rnal 'byor snod/ /dpa' bo chen pos blang bar gyis/ /ḍā ma ru ni shes rab stong pa nyid kyi sgra sgrogs pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ni thabs rig pa byang chub kyis sems lha'i sku/ thod pa bde ba skyong ba/ tshangs pa'i skud pa rnam par mi rtog pa'i thabs shes zung du 'brel ba yin pas na/ de ltar shes par gyis la sems can gyi don gyis shig ces pa'o/ /rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ dpa' bo chen po mi ldog pa'i/ /dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol/ /sems can kun gyi don bgyid phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon bgyid/ lan gsum/ rdo rje 'di nyid hūṃ las rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo dang po'i rdo rje/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad de/ he ru ka dpal dbang bskur bas/ de ring khyod la dbang bskur te/ /rab tu grub phyir rdo rje long*/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñca mi/ tiṣ+ṭha bī ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ lan gsum du gsor la snying gar gtad/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /dril bu 'di nyid āḥlas snyems pa'i ngo bo dang po'i rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dril bu/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyis/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcangs/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ lan gsum mam brgyad du dkrol la/ kha nang du bstan te dku g.yon du phyogs par bzhag la/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /srid pa dam pa byed par gyur/

/rang skad cig gis rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ thod pa'i 'phreng ba'i cod pan can/ /rdo rje dril bu snying gar bsnol/ /yid kyi lus brtan de nyid ni/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig rab tu brjod/ /gang gis lus 'di thams cad brtan/ /des na phyag rgyar rab tu sgrags/ /shes rab bcu drug lon pa la/ / lag pa dag gis yang dag 'khyud/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba/ /slob dpon gyi ni dbang du brjod/ /rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /zung zhig rdo rje byin gyis rlabs/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ oṃ ka kā s+yā/ nas chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rdo rje 'chang chen pos dbu rgyan gyi bar chad dbang gi skabs bzhin/ dbang gi lha thams cad kyang rang la gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe ā hūṃ/ sogs nyer spyod lngas phul/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ me tog spyi bor bzhag ste brtan bzhugs bya/ de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin 'gyur bar/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /lha rnams kun gyi bzhed pa yin/ /sems can rnams ni rjes bzung phyir/ /khyod kyis nan tan bskyed nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin bris nas/ /sgrub pa po rnams sngags la sbyor/ / de nas mtha' rten la/ rjes su gnang ba/ dam tshig sbyin pa/ gzengs bstod pa/ dbugs dbyung ba ste bzhi las/ dang po la lha mchod pa'i rjes gnang*/ de kho na nyid kyi rjes gnang*/ gzhan don chos bshad pa'i rjes gnang*/ gnyis don las dang dngos grub kyi rjes gnang ste bzhi las dang po ni/ sgeg sogs brgyad kyi phyag rgya 'cha' bzhin du/ deng nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' tshogs dang*/ /shes rab thabs bcas snyoms can gyis/

/gar mchod bde ba'i mchod pa bgyis/ /a sgeg dang bcas pa'i 'phreng ba 'phyang*/ /sangs rgyas kun sogs rnal 'byor pa/ /de ni 'bral bar mi 'gyur te/ /phreng ba de yi rgyan yin no/ /oṃ lus can kun la dam chos kyi/ /glu ni khyod kyi blang bar gyis/ /des ni rnal 'byor ma de dang*/ /myur du bde ba myong bar 'gyur/ gī/ de nyid thal mo'i gar gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya/ /sangs rgyas 'dul ba'i 'phrin las gyis/ /gar mkhan tshul du bsgyur bar gyis/ /ho/ sangs rgyas kun la me tog gtor/ /byang chub yan lag tshogs gyur pa'i/ /mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa yin/ /bde gshegs sku ni thob par 'gyur/ /bh+rūṃ/ rdzogs sangs rgyas la spos phul bas/ /brtul bzhugs bzang pos legs tshim gyis/ /lus can bde gshegs cha lugs su/ /ye shes kyis ni tshim par 'gyur/ /a chos kyi me ni legs sbar bas/ /pad+ma gar dbang rang nyid de/ /sems can ma rig ldongs rnams la/ /ye shes sgron me sbar bar gyis/ /pra khyod kyi rgyal la dri phul bas/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang*/ /rnam grol ye shes mthong ba yi/ /byang chub lus can rnams la dgos/ /ghaḥganyis pa ni/ praṃ las byung ba'i mig thur du gyur/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ / 'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyi ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥ a la byung ba'i me long du gyur/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ dag cing gsal ba rnyog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*/ /ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa/ /de ltar chos rnams shes kyis la/ / sems can don ni mnyam med gyis/ /'on kyang rnal 'byor ma sras skyes/ /
