spros pa la dga' na 'dir dril bu dang mda' gzhu dang me long gnyis pa'i rjes gnang yang bya/ gsum pa ni/ dung dang*/ 'khor lo dang*/ po ti dang*/ dril bu rnams sbyin par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra he ru ka maṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bha ga raṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe a/ aḥ sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ / 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /bya ba spyod tshul gsang ba yi/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis/ khyed kyi the tshom dogs med par/ /yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis su/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /dri med kun tu gang bar gyis/ /spros pa la dga' na 'dir rigs sprul bshad kyang bya'o/ / bzhi pa ni/ zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug /sdang bar bya dang gnod sogs dang*/ /bsad dang skrad pa thams cad de/ /las de rnams ni sgrub par gyis/ /ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang*/ /mchil lham de bzhin ril bu ste/ /rnal 'byor ma yi dngos grub ni/ /de ni ci dgar sgrub par gyis/ / gnyis pa dam tshig sbyin pa ni/ nangs par sngar langs sems dag nyid/ /ma lus las 'di byas nas kyang*/ /bsrung dang bza' ba la sogs pa/ /sdom pa'i bdag nyid kun srung ngo*/ /lus dang srog la ltos med par/ /dam tshig dang ni sdom pa bsrung*/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /nyin re bzhin ni bzla bar bya/ /gang tshe nyams gyur rnal 'byor pa/ kha na ma tho sbom por 'gyur/ /dgun zla 'bring po nas brtsams te/ /zla ba re re bsrung ba ni/ /gnyis med gnyis la mi gnas pa/ /tshes bcu la ni bde rab mchod/ / bsdu na de tsam gyis chog la/ spro zhing nus na/ dam tshig gsum sbyin pa nag po spyod pa'i dkyil chog bzhin du rdzogs par 'don no/ /gsum pa gzengs bstod ni/ lugs 'di la lung bstan yin te/ lag pa g.yas skyabs sbyin dang g.yon bla gos kyi grwa nas 'dzin pa'i tshul byed cing*/ he ru ka dpal lung ston bzhin/ /mgrin gcig tu ni thams cad kyis/ /'di ltar nga yis lung bstan te/

/he ru ka dpal de bzhin gshegs/ / dngos po mchog tu grub pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /he badz+ra aṃ ku rī shrī he ru ka na ma sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi sa mā ya bhur bhu ba swa/ gang la tshigs su bcad pa 'di don 'grub pa'i phyag rgyar gnas pa la/ mchog tu grub pa'i tshogs rnams rgyal ba thams cad kyis lung ston par mdzod do/ /bzhi pa dbugs dbyung ba ni/ khams gsum gyi ni rgyal srid che/ /rgyal ba'i bdag por gnas pa dang*/ /der ni bdud las rnam rgyal zhing*/ /grong khyer mchog tu zhugs pa yin/ / der ni sangs rgyas nyid thob par/ /khyed rnams the tshom med pa yin/ /dbang 'di bskur ba tsam gyis kyang*/ /slob ma yon tan bdag por 'gyur/ /slob dpon nyid kyi bde ba yi/ /brtan g.yo kun gyi dam tshig yin/ /de rnams kyi ni dkyil 'khor las/ /rdul tshon nam ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs/ bum pa'i dbang thob pas/ lus kyi dri ma dag /dam tshig rtsa ba dang yan lag gi ltung ba rnams bsrung*/ lam bskyed pa'i rim pa sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal pa can du byas pa yin no/ gsang dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye/ rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pa/ /mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po/ /rdo rje sbyor ba'i yang dag byang*/ /bdag nyid chen po khyod ji bzhin/ /mnga' bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod/ /'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du/ /bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs/ lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab mig dar bcings/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis bdud rtsi gtor/ bla med he ru ka yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgra dang thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/ sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ yab yum gyi sku la zhugs/ thugs kar byang chub kyi sems su zhu/ gsang bar lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes brtan par byas pa'i/

thabs kyi byang chub kyi sems bdag nyid lce thog tu bzhag ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /byang chub sras la dbang bskur ltar/ bdag gi gsang ba'i dbang gi ni/ /sems kyi rgyun gyi dbang bskur ro/ /yum gyi byang chub kyis sems bdag gi khar bab/ 'di de dpa' bo lha mo rnams/ /dam tshig chen po rmad byung ba/ khams lnga las byung bcud kyi len/ bde ba dam pa myong bar byos/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ de ltar na lus kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob pas/ ngag gi dri ma dag dam tshig sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bsten/ lam rang lus thabs ldan gyi rdzogs rim sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i sogs brjod do/ /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsang dbang ltar gsol ba btab/ mig dar bcings/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ bdud rtsi gtor/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rig ma dngos grub kyi don tu phyag rgyar gtad/ dga' ster gnas ster lha mo ni/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma/ /zung zhig zung zhig sems dpa' che/ /zung la mchod pa rtag tu gyis/ /rig ma des kyang 'di skad ces/ / bshang gci dag ni bza' ba dang*/ khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te/ /sha chen bsten par bu spro'am/ /bud med rnams la rtag gus dang*/ /bha ga'i pad+mar tsum pa rnams/ /bu khyod ji ltar dga' bar smos/ zhes dris pa la/ lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro/ khu khrag la sogs bza' ba dang*/ /bud med rnams la rtag gus shing*/ / pad+ma'i bha ga cis mi len/ zhes lan btab/ des kyang skye gnas mchog gi rtsa gsal bar byas nas/ e ma bdag gi pad+ma ni/ /bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /gal te cho ga bzhin bsten na/ /de yi mdun na nga 'dug ste/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa la sogs pa/ /bya ba thams cad pad+mar byed/ /bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni/ /'di nyid du ni rtag tu zhugs/ /bhaṃ dza mo k+ṣa ho/ zhes dbang du byon/ rang nyid he ru ka phyag gnyis pa dang*/

rig ma rdo rje phag mor gyur yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ dkar por nas rgyas shing brtan par gyur/ gyi bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis gdong g.yogs dkrol/ de ltar na bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob pas sems kyi dri ma dag dam tshig tu shes rab ma'i rigs la smad par mi bya/ lam dngos dang ye shes kyi rig ma bsten pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ / dbang bzhi pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ khyod zhabs pad+mo'i bka' drin gyis/ /gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob/ /de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang*/ /bdag la bka' drin skyabs du gsol/ / lan gsum gyi gsol ba gdab/ de ltar yang sdom pa 'byung ba las/ / rnam pa sna tshogs dri med pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni spro bar gnang*/ /lhan cig skyes pa bzhi pa'i ming*/ /bde ba kun gyi gnas de bzhin/ zhes dang*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i snang brnyan tsam/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal ba'o/ / zhes dang*/ yul dang yul can sbyor ba yis/ /rtog pa med pa'i go 'phang 'gyur/ / zhes pa'i don la mnyam par bzhag /de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob pas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag dam tshig tu dgongs te gsungs pa bzhi'i don sgrub/ lam bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyid/ lan gsum/ bka' drin gtang rag gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ deng nas brtsam ste bdag bran du/ khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags kyi/ khyed kyi slob mar bzung ba dang*/ /cha shas kyis spyad du gsol/ lan gsum/ dge ba bsngo/ spros pa la dga' na/ oṃ nam mkha' skye ba mtshan ldan phyir/

zhes sogs dam tshig gsum gyi glu blang ngo*/ /bcu pa slob ma bzung ba ni/ bdag 'jug las dpag te shes par 'gyur la/ lag len gyi khyad par phra mo rnams slob dpon gyi gsung dang*/ mthong ba rgyud pa las shes par 'gyur zhing*/ slob ma la bgegs sbyangs dang*/ sdig pa sbyangs pa gnyis las sam/ dri ma sbyangs pa ste/ sbyang ba gsum char yang byed pa'i srol yod pa/ 'jug pa'i skabs kyi gnas skabs snga phyi ma nges pa zhig lag len so so la snang yang*/ 'jug pa'i gsol gdab grub ma thag tu byas na legs par mngon la/ ye shes 'bebs pa'i rdzas ni mi ro'i khar bcug pa'i gu gul dang byi la nag po'i brun/ gzhon nu ma'i rngul gyis gos pa'i ras/ bdud rtsi lnga rnams bsres pa thod pa'i nang du dur khrod kyi me la bsreg par bshad la/ gzhan mi 'dra ba'ang ci rigs par snang ngo*/ khyad par phra mo 'ga' re bdag 'jug gi zhor la'ang bshad zin la/ go don rgyas pa ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /bcu gcig pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ slob ma la dbang bskur ba yin na/ slob ma rnams dkyil 'khor khang par bzhag slob dpon bdag nyid dkyil 'khor khang pa'i phyi rol tu song nas/ 'byung po thams cad kyi gtor ma rgya cher btang nang du zhugs nas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo la phyag bya'o/ / sbyin sreg dang*/ tshogs kyi 'khor los kyang lha rnams mnyes par bya'o/ /yongs ni dngos gzhi'i dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i dus dang*/ slob ma dbang bskur zin pa'i dus dang*/ dkyil 'khor gshegs zin pa'i shul du yang me'i las dang 'khor lo'i mchod pa'i lha mnyes par bya ste/ rang nyid kho nas don gyi mchod pa la yang*/ gnas skabs gnyis po der sgrub bo/ /de nas rjes chog dngos ni/ mchod pa rgya cher bshams/ byin gyis rlabs/ mchod yon sogs dang*/ rig ma bcu drug dang*/ nang mchod gsang mchod/ rkang brgyad kyi bstod pa rnams byas la/ dkyil 'khor mchod pa byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngos/

dkyil 'khor du lan gsum bskor ba bya/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams bdag cag la dgongs su gsol/ khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rjes/ mdzad pa'i 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas/ spyir phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang*/ sems can la bde skyid 'byung ba dang*/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs shing*/ zhal bzhugs pa rnams sku khams bzang ba dang*/ khyad par du yang bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor ba dang bcas pas thog drangs/ sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag nas/ myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ lho phyogs nas yig brgya bzla/ ma 'byor pa dang*/ sogs sam/ ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang*/ zhes sogs kyi/ bzod par gsol/ bdag cag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas/ sems sgrib pa dang ldan pa dang*/ yo byad ma tshang ba dang*/ ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang*/ sngags ma dag pa dang*/ cho ga lhag pa dang chad pa thams cad lhag chad kha bskong zhing*/ bdag cag gi lam dang dngos grub kyi bar chad du mi 'gyur bar mdzad du gsol/ bdag gi las dang dngos grub thams cad thogs pa med par 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor yin nam/ ma yin kyang rten gzhan yod na brtan bzhugs bya ste/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du/ rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu yang*/ sku gzugs kyi rten 'di rnams la zhes sam/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la zhes sam/ sku gzugs kyi rten 'di rnams dang ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la/

zhes pa gang 'os skabs dang sbyar te/ bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs thams cad/ ji srid 'byung ba chen po sa chu me rlung gi gnod sa'i ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas kyang bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen dam pa mdzad du gsol/ zhes me tog dor/ rdul tshon gyis dkyil 'khor yin la/ gzhan rten sku sogs med cing sgrub mchod zhag sprel byed pa'i skabs/ nyi ma snga ma rnams la rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor ba thams cad gshegs su ma gsol bar gyis brtan bzhugs kyi rdul tshon gshegs gsol gyi nyin mo de yang mi dgos so/ /de nas gshegs gsol ni/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes te zhag sbrel mar byed pa'i nyi ma snga ma rnams la ni/ rten la ma brten pa'i mgron kho na gshegs su gsol ba yin zhing*/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bsdu pa'i skabs yin na/ de'i steng du bum bskyed kyang gshegs dgos la/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i dus ni dkyil 'khor ba yang gshegs pa yin te/ de yang badz+ra muḥ yan gyis mgron rnams gshegs/ bum bskyed dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha nyid bstan las 'phags te nam mkhar bzhugs pa la / oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3 haṃ/ zhes rnam lnga 'dod bskor dang 'khyud rgya byas pas/ de rnams rang nyid la thim par mos so/ /gnas skabs 'di lta bu thams cad la/ slob dpon phal cher dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ ye shes pa gshegs par mdzad/ bod kyi chen po kha cigade go bzlog par bzhed/ 'ga' zhig dam ye ma phye bar rang la st-im par bzhed de/ so sor rgyu mtshan dang bcas te gsungs pa/ spyir thams cad rung ba yin kyang*/ phyi ma bzang bar mthong bas 'dir de ltar bya'o/
